profile_val_desc: This value (1-10) indicates the reliability of your score. It corresponds to the number of unique days from which the current result is calculated. For an objective assessment we recommend reaching a green validity (at least 8/10).
profile_info_wm_desc: Ability to hold and mentally process information in real time.
profile_info_wm_calc: Weighted average of Dual N-Back (60%) and Digit Span (40%).
profile_info_vs_desc: Ability to perceive and remember spatial relationships and visual layouts.
profile_info_vs_prac: Navigating a new city or parking.
profile_info_vs_calc: Combination of capacity reached in eCorsi (80%) and Dual N-Back (20%).
profile_info_exe_desc: Mental brake. Ability to suppress impulses and flexibly switch rules.
profile_info_exe_prac: Stopping an inappropriate reaction and quick adaptation to plan changes.
profile_info_exe_calc: Based primarily on the Stroop test (70%) and Dual N-Back (30%).
profile_info_asc_desc: Ability to form memory links between seemingly unrelated things.
profile_info_asc_prac: Learning foreign words or remembering a name to a new face.
profile_info_asc_calc: Pure maximum capacity mastered in the Memory Palace.
profile_info_att_desc: Alertness and processing speed. How fast and accurately your brain reads a situation.
profile_info_att_prac: Observation in traffic and reading in a busy environment without distraction.
profile_info_att_calc: Evenly composed of the Stroop test (50%) and Dual N-Back (50%).
dialog_exit_body: Cognitive growth requires consistency. Do you really want to exit the app?
global_interrupt_body: Unsaved progress from this session will be lost.
ds_interrupt_body: The cognitive session will be terminated and progress will not be saved.
stroop_inst_match: DOES THE WORD MATCH THE COLOR?
about_privacy_text: Your cognitive data and training results are stored exclusively locally on your device. To continuously improve the app, we only collect completely anonymous technical data about errors and crashes (using Firebase). The app contains no ads and requires no registration.
about_privacy_text_clean: The app is developed with an emphasis on absolute privacy and openness. All your data, training results, and settings are stored exclusively locally on your device. The app is completely offline, contains no tracking elements, ads, or analytics tools, and does not communicate with any external servers.
about_support_text: Kognisinn is developed in free time and completely free of charge and with no ads and no data collection. If the app helps you then you can support its further development with a symbolic coffee. Thank you!
calib_intro_desc: Discover your cognitive baseline in 5 short tests.
calib_stroop_desc: Select the text color and not the word itself. Speed is key.
calib_digit_desc: Remember the displayed numbers. Ends on first mistake.
calib_palace_desc: Memorize the words and their order.
calib_dnb_desc: Watch for position and audio match (Level N=1).
calib_done_desc: Your cognitive baseline has been successfully calculated.
profile_debug_reset: DEBUG: Delete data and repeat calibration
ds_info_goal_desc: Increase working memory capacity and the ability to mentally manipulate data.
ds_info_rules_desc: Memorize the displayed sequence of numbers and enter it back according to the selected mode (forward or reverse).
ds_info_prac_desc: Better focus during conversation and keeping numbers in your head (e.g. when copying codes).
dnb_info_goal_desc: Increase the capacity of continuous working memory updating and divided attention.
dnb_info_rules_desc: Watch the grid and listen to the letters. Press the button if the current position or sound matches the one N steps back.
dnb_info_prac_desc: Filtering out distractions keeping multiple pieces of information at once and fluidly solving complex problems.
ecorsi_info_goal_desc: Increase visuospatial memory capacity and orientation.
ecorsi_info_rules_desc: Watch the lighting blocks and repeat their exact sequence (forward or reverse).
ecorsi_info_prac_desc: Navigating in a new space and remembering a route or the layout of things on a desk.
palace_info_goal_desc: Increase associative memory capacity and visualization skills.
palace_info_rules_desc: Mentally link the displayed object to the given room in the palace. Then recall what was where.
palace_info_prac_desc: Learning foreign vocabulary names of new people or preparing for exams.
stroop_info_goal_desc: Increase executive control and the ability to ignore distracting stimuli.
stroop_info_rules_desc:
The Stroop test measures cognitive flexibility and the ability to suppress an automatic response (inhibition).

• Classic mode: Identify the FONT COLOR and ignore the written word.
• Reverse mode: Identify the WRITTEN WORD and ignore the font color.

The goal is to answer as quickly as possible and avoid mistakes.
stroop_info_prac_desc: Maintaining attention in a noisy environment and quick decision making under pressure.
onboard_1_desc: Scientifically backed, fully offline, and 100% private. Your brain, your data.
onboard_2_desc: Improve your working memory, executive control, and decision-making speed with 5 key tests.
onboard_3_desc: Instead of reading long rules, let's start right away. Let's find out your initial cognitive baseline.
calib_dnb_help_pos:
POSITION:
Press if the square is in the same position as 2 steps ago.
calib_dnb_help_aud:
AUDIO:
Press if you hear the same letter as 2 steps ago.
onboard_haptic_desc: Physical feedback is required for proper training. Test the vibration. If you don't feel it, adjust your settings.
onboard_disclaimer_desc: Kognisinn is not a medical device. It is intended for general cognitive training only and should not be used to diagnose or treat any medical or psychological conditions.
onboard_disclaimer_checkbox: I understand and acknowledge the limitations of this app.
onboard_disclaimer_error: Please acknowledge the disclaimer to continue.
onboarding_gamification_desc: Although the training modules correspond to scientific methodology, we offer a gamified scoring system to give you a better idea of your progress. An average beginner achieves a score of 100, and the theoretical human maximum is around 200. This score is not calculated by any standardized scientific method; it is just our rough estimate to keep you motivated. Do you want to display these gamified values?
